title: A literature comparison matrix
outcome: Explain a literature comparison matrix using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: A literature matrix that preserves differences. Two fictional studies evaluate related tools under different conditions.
given: Study S1: 8/10 correct on indoor photos. S2: 16/20 on outdoor photos. Both report 80%.

steps.label: Record each method
steps.detail: Keep population, task, model version and scoring in separate columns.

steps.label: Compare rates carefully
steps.detail: Both rates are 80%, with different denominators and conditions.

steps.label: Name missing comparison
steps.detail: Neither study directly compares both tools on the same photos.

explanation: A literature matrix helps compare evidence without flattening differences. Equal percentages do not mean equivalent tasks, samples or methods.

counterfactual.prediction: The matrix conceals an important condition difference.
counterfactual.reason: A reader might now mistake unlike studies for a controlled head-to-head comparison.

student_task: Explain why 8/10 indoors and 16/20 outdoors share a rate but not a controlled comparison. Which condition column must the literature matrix preserve?
teacher_answer: Keep population, task, model version and scoring in separate columns. Both rates are 80%, with different denominators and conditions. Neither study directly compares both tools on the same photos. Changed case: The matrix conceals an important condition difference. A reader might now mistake unlike studies for a controlled head-to-head comparison.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: These fictional studies illustrate comparison practice; no real literature finding is asserted.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.
